title: Star Trek Franchise Overview
body:
Star Trek began as a television series created by Gene Roddenberry, first broadcast in 1966, and grew into multiple television series, films, books and games, all documented in public broadcast and release records.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — series titles, creators, broadcast and release years and formats — in original wording, with no copied scripts or dialogue.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original crews and starships, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by the rights holders.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

title: Star Trek Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Star Trek: The Original Series (1966) and ending with Star Trek: Strange New Worlds (2022). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

The full order is: Star Trek: The Original Series (1966); Star Trek: The Motion Picture (1979); Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan (1982); Star Trek: The Next Generation (1987); Star Trek: Deep Space Nine (1993); Star Trek: Voyager (1995); Star Trek: Enterprise (2001); Star Trek: Discovery (2017); Star Trek: Picard (2020); Star Trek: Strange New Worlds (2022). Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.

This guide contains facts only. It does not reproduce story text, and it does not claim that any Signature continuation belongs in the official order.
